access_isolation.access_manifest: frozen before selection reveal or truth opening
access_isolation.environment: cleared and replaced with an allowlisted offline environment
access_isolation.evaluator_private: private mapping, truth, target LoRA, and evaluator evidence absent
access_isolation.failure_policy: any schema, mount, permission, access-probe, or network-probe failure exits nonzero
access_isolation.mechanism: unshare user, mount, network, and PID namespaces; minimal chroot; read-only binds for exact code, sanitized input, public inverse state, pinned public model/tokenizer and Python runtime; tmpfs temporary space; one empty writable method output
access_isolation.network: new namespace with no interface route; denial probe required
access_isolation.permissions: public inputs and runtime read-only; output is the only writable bind
access_isolation.workspace: repository and host workspace absent from chroot

artifacts.retention: retain all local raw artifacts through review; commit hashes, byte counts, commands, outputs, statuses, and required compact evidence

causal_public_surrogate_search.cache: fork public DynamicCache for batched candidates; commit only the winner
causal_public_surrogate_search.candidate_source: the direct inverse's frozen top-16 lists
causal_public_surrogate_search.commit: highest cosine score; frozen proposal rank then token-ID ascending tie break
causal_public_surrogate_search.family: causal candidate generation and public-surrogate simulation
causal_public_surrogate_search.prefix: declared BOS followed only by already committed reconstructed tokens
causal_public_surrogate_search.score: one-minus-cosine between the candidate's public-prefix cut activation and the permitted observed activation at that position

direct_inverse.candidate_scores: cosine similarity to every normalized public input embedding
direct_inverse.cut_0: identity map from observed embedding to normalized public embeddings
direct_inverse.cuts_4_and_8: independent residual affine 2048-to-2048 maps trained on public-surrogate activations to predict normalized input embeddings
direct_inverse.direct_output: highest-scoring token with token-ID ascending tie break
direct_inverse.hyperparameter_selection: fixed here; no blind or development metric selects a variant

claim_scope.target_update: the exact evaluator-only rank-4 LoRA artifact produced by this plan

matched_public_control.blind_records: same 64 records, reconstructed and frozen before shared truth opening
matched_public_control.target_prefix: the pinned public checkpoint without the target update

primary.target_prefix: base embedding plus target-specific LoRA-modified decoder layers; callable target prefix and LoRA state remain evaluator-only

cost_accounting.causal: proposal, causal selection, and total runtime separately per arm, record, and scored token
cost_accounting.complexity: source lines and executable statement counts for method-common and method-specific code
cost_accounting.direct: proposal and total runtime separately per arm, record, and scored token
cost_accounting.evaluations: full-vocabulary embedding comparisons and candidate simulations counted exactly
cost_accounting.memory: pre-method preparation and reset per-method CUDA peaks plus process max RSS
cost_accounting.separation: direct and causal execute in distinct fresh processes with reset CUDA counters
cost_accounting.training: zero fresh training/adaptation; exact persisted state bytes and hashes recorded

roles.4: primary shallow cut aligned with the historical comparator

data.padding: none; only rows with at least 39 source tokens are eligible

selection.disjointness: all original target-update, inverse-train, development, blind, excluded-attempt, and reproducibility records are excluded
selection.eligibility: at least 39 source tokens; prepend exactly one declared BOS

data.truncation: first 39 source tokens in tokenizer order

current_deviations.required_revision: fresh opaque committed split and process-enforced access boundary

deviation_policy.material_changes: record what changed, why, decision time, whether pre-truth, and effects on comparability or claim scope

post_freeze_pre_truth: reveal selection key and private mapping
verify HMAC commitment, keyed ordering, eligibility, opaque order, and disjointness
open clean truth only through the combined freeze, access, and commitment gate
post_truth: score frozen direct and causal outputs without revision
perform the post-hoc original-run opaque-ID noninterference audit
pre_freeze: commit this revision plan and public hiding commitment
generate evaluator-only fresh observations and sanitized reconstruction inputs
validate strict schemas and verify exact retained state hashes
export exact reconstruction code and public runtime dependencies
run access probes and direct method in its isolated process
run access probes and causal method in its separate isolated process
freeze sanitized inputs, method outputs, routes, configuration, and access manifests
verify freeze receipt and isolation evidence

hashes: sanitized observation index and reconstruction configuration
direct and causal candidates, scores, predictions, queries, routes, timings, and counters
isolation identity, mount, permission, environment, and denial-probe manifests
freeze_contract.mutation_policy: create-only files made read-only; any byte, path, schema, or access mismatch fails closed

historical_comparator.action: do not run it as a scientific arm; retain its verified preflight and audit
historical_comparator.reason: The exact code and public teacher assets are runnable, but the frozen comparator requires a 128x128 source geometry and a three-episode prior-trace adaptation contract. Applying it to the 64x40 Pile/LoRA condition would alter its fixed contract and would not be the exact historical comparator.

metrics.primary: token accuracy excluding BOS and padding at cut 4 in unavailable_target_lora
required: token accuracy excluding BOS and padding
correct prefix length and first-error position
frozen top-k true-token recall and exact true-token rank
conditional selection accuracy when truth is in the frozen candidates
end-to-end runtime per record and scored token
phase timings including preparation, training, proposal, reconstruction, synchronization, and I/O
trainable parameter count and persisted state bytes

post_truth_diagnostics.activation_matching: frozen chosen and candidate score distributions labeled correct/incorrect after truth
error_propagation: accuracy before and after each record's first frozen output error
teacher-prefix public-surrogate counterfactual after truth opening
post_truth_diagnostics.proposal_vs_ranking: top-16 recall and causal conditional accuracy

token_groups.numeric: contains a Unicode decimal digit and all other non-whitespace characters are punctuation
token_groups.punctuation: all non-whitespace decoded characters are Unicode punctuation
token_groups.whitespace_prefixed: decoded token begins whitespace or raw token begins Ġ

dataset.role: public auxiliary, development, and blind source

tokenizer.bos_insertion: prepend exactly once after source tokenization

revision.purpose: access-compliant clean confirmation with a fresh disjoint split

seeds.fresh_record_selection: evaluator-private cryptographic 256-bit key; value withheld until post-freeze reveal

statistics.effect_sizes: absolute percentage-point quality differences and multiplicative cost ratios
statistics.improvement_rule: claim improvement only for supported quality gain at like-for-like budget, supported cost reduction at like-for-like quality, or a reported Pareto improvement; otherwise call the comparison inconclusive
statistics.paired_differences: causal minus direct within each record, condition, and cut; target minus matched control for mismatch

target_prefix_update.decision_time: fixed by the original preregistration and R1 packet; exact retained artifact reused
target_prefix_update.modules: q_proj and v_proj in decoder layers 0,1,2,3
target_prefix_update.objective: next-token cross-entropy on BOS plus first 39 public source tokens
